stem_en: Based on the facts stated, which two entities most directly match the material's higher-risk indicators and require additional review before onboarding? (Select Two.)

options_en.A: A large multinational corporation with extensive, documented wire transfer activity.
options_en.B: A local convenience store that replenishes the on-site automated teller machine (ATM) with cash from its till.
options_en.C: A local used car sales lot that allows individuals to pay their monthly bill in cash.
options_en.D: A virtual asset service provider (VASP) facilitating peer-to-peer cryptocurrency transactions.
